autonomous_operation.rule: NO USER QUESTIONS when files/credentials are available
autonomous_operation.description: Always research VPS, system files, .env, credentials FIRST before asking user
examples: Use available service keys for direct operations

work_delegation.description: Execute tasks autonomously, only report results

persistent_documentation.description: Document every user instruction in manifest for future Manus units

steps: 4. Only ask if truly impossible to proceed

implementation_notes.for_future_manus: This directive applies to ALL Manus units (A, B, C, etc.)
implementation_notes.documentation_requirement: Must be included in every system handover
implementation_notes.user_expectation: Autonomous operation with minimal user intervention

examples_of_correct_behavior: Find Supabase credentials in .env → Execute SQL schema directly
Locate system files on VPS → Implement changes autonomously
Research existing configurations → Apply updates without asking
Document all changes → Report completion to user
examples_of_incorrect_behavior: Asking for credentials when they exist in .env
Requesting user to execute SQL when service key available
Multiple options questions when clear path exists
Not documenting directives for future reference

enforcement.handover_requirement: Must be part of Manus-to-Manus transitions
enforcement.user_feedback_loop: User will indicate if directive is violated
